name: 40 Hz gamma, magnetic square (GENUS timing)
origin: Timing from the Tsai lab's GENUS light and sound flicker (MIT Picower Institute; Cognito Therapeutics trials); the magnetic version is a project construct
summary: A 40 Hz on/off square field (12.5 ms on, 12.5 ms off) on all eight ring coils in phase for 1 h. The on/off timing is that of the Tsai lab's GENUS light flicker (Iaccarino 2016). GENUS is sensory stimulation with light and sound; a magnetic 40 Hz field is this project's own design: no source describes one, and it has no evidence.
notes: GENUS (gamma entrainment using sensory stimuli) is a light flickering at 40 Hz, '12.5 ms light on, 12.5 ms light off', for 1 h (Iaccarino 2016 l.143). Martorell 2019 added a 1-ms 10 kHz tone every 25 ms, 'coupled with' the light pulses (l.123), 1 h a day. No source describes a magnetic 40 Hz exposure. This program copies only the on/off timing of the light, as a unipolar magnetic square wave on the full ring with all coils in phase. Light and sound are left out: they would need new hardware (a GPIO-driven LED and I2S audio on the ESP32), so the part of GENUS that has data is missing here. For a bipolar square use the square40 table generator; the smooth version is lowfield-gamma-40hz-sine. The sources state no field strength, because they use light and sound; the 5 uT is this project's choice. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. A magnetic 40 Hz field has no evidence. The sensory results are themselves contested: Soula 2023 found no gamma entrainment or amyloid change from 40 Hz light in mice, the human data are small trials (e.g. Chan 2022), and a meta-analysis (Ang 2025) found no established cognitive benefit. This program is not a treatment for Alzheimer's disease or any other condition. If you add 40 Hz light flicker from another device, screen for photosensitive epilepsy first and offer a sound-only mode; the same meta-analysis raised a tinnitus signal for the sound. Not for people with epilepsy; stop on headache or distress.
setting: Seated and relaxed, eyes open or closed, in a quiet room.
schedule: The GENUS studies used 1 h a day (Chan et al. 2022: daily for 3 months). No schedule has been tested for a magnetic 40 Hz field.
source: Iaccarino et al. 2016, Nature 540:230 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5656389/ ; Martorell et al. 2019, Cell 177:256 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6774262/ ; Soula et al. 2023, Nat Neurosci https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10839995/ ; Chan et al. 2022, PLoS One https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9714926/ ; Ang et al. 2025, meta-analysis https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12700959/
